description: A pulse ratcheter: each incoming pulse comes back out as a burst of repeats, with the number of repeats picked at random between a minimum and a maximum

params.text: With it off every pulse is ratcheted; with it on the probability knob governs which pulses are ratcheted and which are passed over
The chance that a pulse is ratcheted, from 0 for never to 1 for every time

inputs.text: The clock the repeat timing is measured from
A voltage moving the smallest number of repeats a burst can have
A voltage moving the largest number of repeats a burst can have

notes: the two red displays set the smallest and largest number of repeats a burst can have, and are set by clicking them; with both the same, every burst has that many repeats
the spacing of the repeats is measured from the pulses at the clock input, so a clock has to be patched there for a burst to be timed.
